title: Chapter 64: Ate It?
html:
The mirror monster had Chen Ge in a chokehold, and the murderer was closing in with a knife. There was no time to hesitate. The moment Zhang Ya’s page appeared, he reached out to type two words—Help me!

The strange laughter in his head grew louder. Zhang Peng lunged with the knife before Chen Ge could type anything else. Twisting around, Chen Ge snatched whatever he could reach from the cupboard and hurled it at him.

His limbs were failing, and the veins stood out along his neck. Even if Zhang Peng never stabbed him, the mirror monster would strangle him to death. Chen Ge clawed desperately at his throat but found nothing to grasp, as though his attacker did not exist. His last hope lay with the black phone.

He turned toward the phone on the floor. A line of blood-red text had appeared on the screen. “She has understood your request. Please accept the terms of the first agreement.”

Apparently, the arrangement worked both ways. If Chen Ge asked something of Zhang Ya, she would demand something in return, and she would not carry out his request until he accepted.

At a time like this, Chen Ge would have accepted any terms, no matter how outrageous. He edged his finger forward and pressed “yes.”

The instant his finger touched the screen, the temperature plummeted. Icy drafts swept in from every corner, and the strange laughter in his head abruptly ceased. The monster on his back shuddered. It, too, could feel fear.

A sudden dripping sound filled the room, as though something had begun to leak. The mirror monster released Chen Ge and fled back into Zhang Peng’s body.

The maintenance room fell eerily silent. Even Zhang Peng sensed that something was wrong. Yet the desperate gambler refused to retreat. He raised the knife and charged Chen Ge.

He had taken only one step when his expression changed. The mirror monster seized control of his body and tried to force him away. Man and ghost fought over the same body, leaving it frozen in place. Meanwhile, Chen Ge’s shadow slowly rose from the floor, and a blood-red dress appeared behind him.

Zhang Ya had clearly traumatized both man and ghost at Western Jiujiang’s Private Academy. The moment they saw the Red Specter behind Chen Ge, they reached an instant accord and turned to run.

Freed from the mirror monster’s grip, Chen Ge sucked in a breath. Zhang Peng had nearly killed him, and his anger still burned. He was not about to let them escape so easily.

He had barely risen with the iron hammer when the Red Specter struck. Zhang Ya relished cruel deaths; without waiting for an order, needle-fine strands of black hair shot into Zhang Peng’s body.

The murderer faltered. Chen Ge seized the opening and brought the iron hammer down on Zhang Peng’s shoulder. The impact pitched the man forward, and Chen Ge followed with another blow to the back of his knee.

An ear-splitting shriek rang from the maintenance room. Realizing its host was trapped, the mirror monster abandoned Zhang Peng and flew toward the bathroom.

“Oh no! There’s a mirror in the first-floor bathroom!”

Before Chen Ge could react, Zhang Ya pursued the mirror monster, plainly fascinated by the shadowy creature.

I have to figure out a way to block the mirror.

Chen Ge looked around and spotted the half-full vat of fake blood in the maintenance room. The bathroom door creaked in the wind. By the time he reached it, Zhang Ya’s hair had already pierced half the creature’s body, but it was only inches from the mirror.

“You’re not getting away that easily this time!”

Unsure whether it would help, Chen Ge splashed the fake blood across the mirror. The black shadow hesitated. Before it could react, tendrils of hair coiled around its body like snakes, swallowing its humanoid outline beneath layer after layer of black.

The bloody dress fluttered in the wind. Once Zhang Ya tired of her captive, she tore the ball of compressed shadow in two. She swallowed one half, shredded the other, and gently blew the fragments into Chen Ge’s face.

Something slipped into Chen Ge’s eyes, and a sudden chill sent a shudder through him.

“What was that?” Chen Ge wanted an answer, but having fulfilled her side of the agreement, the merciless Red Specter sank back into his shadow.

The bathroom door continued to squeak on its hinges, but nothing inside suggested that the madness Chen Ge had witnessed had ever happened.

Just like that, Zhang Ya ate half the mirror monster and blew the rest into my eyes.Chen Ge stared at the mirror, overcome by a dreamlike sense of unreality. Now that the mirror monster is gone, no new number should appear on the mirror tomorrow night… right?

He still did not understand what the numbers meant, but he sensed that they concealed an enormous secret.

After closing the door, Chen Ge called the police. This time, he spared Inspector Lee. The man was not a machine, and Chen Ge had already given him more than enough to handle over the past few days.

Leaning against the wall, Chen Ge glanced at Zhang Peng, who lay like a corpse on the floor. The mirror monster had taken something with it when it left his body. His eyes stared blankly ahead, utterly lifeless.

I suppose this is a kind of karma.

At six in the morning, investigators from the city bureau, officers from Western Jiujiang Police Station, and members of the park management gathered outside the Haunted House. The final suspect in the Ping An Apartments case had been caught at last.

After watching Zhang Peng being hauled into the police car, Chen Ge’s taut nerves finally relaxed. He did not stay to chat but returned to the Haunted House and locked himself in the breakroom.

The Ping An Apartments case is finally over. Zhang Ya ate the mirror monster, so there shouldn’t be any hidden threats left in my Haunted House. I can open every scenario for business this morning.Lying in bed, Chen Ge considered his next move. I need to focus on expanding the Haunted House. The new scenarios won’t unlock until I do. Once I wake up, I’ll talk to Uncle Xu. Somehow, I have to convince him to rent me the underground parking lot.

As he tried to sleep, a cold breeze brushed over him. Even wrapped in the covers, he could not escape the chill. It seemed to be coming from his eyes.

Zhang Ya did blow part of the mirror monster into my face. Could that be causing this?Chen Ge picked up a small mirror and examined himself. Everything looked normal, except that his pupils seemed darker, like the surface of a bottomless lake.

Eventually, fatigue caught up to him. Chen Ge placed the mirror underneath his pillow and soon drifted off to sleep.

At 10:30 a.m., after barely a few hours of sleep, a phone call woke Chen Ge. He checked the caller ID and answered. “Xiao Wan, take the morning off. Come in this afternoon.”

“Boss! There are so many people down here! There are even police and reporters, what have you done?!”
